facts.fact: The ONECI director general says the convention with Orange Bank Africa is legally framed by personal data protection rules, with the authorisation of ARTICI.
The ONECI director general says the convention with Orange Bank Africa was made with the authorisation of ARTICI, under personal data protection rules.
